Subject: Sandbox stasis request while PO clears - Novus Health

Diego —

Quick one: procurement has put our PO on hold pending an extra vendor questionnaire (ugh). Finance says the formal PO will be routing next week at the earliest; Jared copied here. We're in the middle of a live integration test and the team will lose momentum if the sandbox times out.

Can Redwood keep our sandbox in a frozen/stasis state (read: no auto-expiry) or grant a small complementary token cushion for 7–10 days while procurement finishes? We can provide the PO draft now (attached) and will route the signed PO as soon as approvals are done.

Appreciate any help — this pilot is time-sensitive for our Q4 roadmap and getting it back up after it lapses will cost us both time.

Thanks,

Kimberly / Marissa — forwarding Novus Health's note. They have an active integration test and procurement stalled on an extra vendor questionnaire; PO draft attached. Customer asks for a 7–10 day stasis or small token cushion while PO clears.

Context: Novus is evaluating Redwood for a clinical records ingestion + summarization feature. They ran a lightweight pilot (low token usage) but are mid-integration. If we let the sandbox expire it will slow adoption materially. Deal is DEAL-2027-0543; ask is modest.

Proposal I think we can support without precedent headaches: grant a 10-day sandbox hold (freeze timer) and a one-time 35k token credit to preserve momentum. We'll require PO within the 10 days or we retract. If finance wants this as a formal approval, I can send the PO draft and a brief approval note to the customer.

Can you confirm? If approved I'll reply to Alyssa with the exact terms, attach approval, and link the HubSpot deal.

— Diego

- Grant a 10-calendar-day sandbox stasis starting from 2027-07-29 (timer frozen, no expiry).
